title: Work orders card has 'Full View' and 'Tech view' pills
expected: View mode section (subtitle 'Controls interface complexity, not access controls.') shows two pills: 'Full View' and 'Tech view'
actual: Work orders card contains a 'View mode' section with subtitle 'Controls interface complexity, not access controls.' and two segmented pills: 'Full View' and 'Tech view'

title: Full View info panel text
expected: Info panel titled 'Full View': 'Complete interface with all fields visible and editable (subject to CRUD permissions). The estimate column shows the actual estimate value. Full parts request form with all fields. All workflow actions available (approve, review, split etc...).'
actual: With Full View selected the info panel reads exactly: 'Full View - Complete interface with all fields visible and editable (subject to CRUD permissions). The estimate column shows the actual estimate value. Full parts request form with all fields. All workflow actions available (approve, review, split etc...).'
reason: Info panel text matches expected verbatim

title: Tech view info panel text (pill disabled until a WO CRUD permission is enabled)
expected: Blank editor: Tech view pill DISABLED until a Work orders CRUD is enabled; after enabling Work orders View, Tech view panel shows 'Simplified interface focused on the technician workflow. Non-essential fields are hidden to reduce clutter, and only the actions a technician needs day-to-day are shown.'
actual: In blank editor the Tech view pill is DISABLED (isDisabled=true). After clicking the Work orders 'View' checkbox the Tech view pill became enabled (isDisabled=false); selecting it surfaced the info panel containing 'Simplified interface focused on the technician workflow...'
reason: Disabled-until-CRUD gating and Tech view panel text both confirmed

title: Tech view restriction 3: cannot approve work orders (approve button hidden)
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST as Tech, view_mode=tech (workOrdersView+CreateAndEdit, WOL Create&Edit, Review WO, SFD on) vs same role view_mode=full
expected: No Approve WO button present in Tech view
actual: 1:1 comparison on the same WO (047ffbc5): Full View shows an 'Approve' action button; Tech View shows no Approve button anywhere (only 'New Line' and an edit-shop-supplies affordance)
reason: Approve WO button hidden in Tech view, confirmed against Full View on the same WO

title: Tech view restriction (new): 'Send to Portal' button is hidden
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST as Tech, view_mode=tech (Review WO on, Customer Portal on, WOL Create&Edit) vs same role view_mode=full
expected: 'Send to Portal' not visible anywhere on the WO in Tech view
actual: 1:1 comparison on the same WO (047ffbc5): Full View shows a 'Send to Portal' (how_to_reg) button; Tech View shows no 'Send to Portal' button in header, line-level, or action buttons
reason: Send to Portal hidden in Tech view, confirmed against Full View on the same WO

title: Full View user who can approve a WOL: 'Send to Portal' button is visible
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST as Tech, view_mode=full (WOL Create&Edit, Review WO, Customer Portal on, SFD on)
expected: 'Send to Portal' button visible (Full View + ability to approve WOL); clicking initiates the Send to Portal flow
actual: On WO 047ffbc5 in Full View with WOL Create&Edit + Review Work Orders + Customer Portal ON, the 'Send to Portal' (how_to_reg) button is visible alongside 'Approve' and 'New Line'
reason: Send to Portal button visible in Full View with approve-WOL ability (the gating behavior); actual click/send intentionally not executed to avoid customer-facing side effects on shared staging

title: Financial column visibility controlled by See Financial Data, not View mode
role_used: Full+SFD OFF (User A) and Tech+SFD ON (User B), same WO
expected: User A (Full, SFD OFF) sees NO financial data; User B (Tech, SFD ON) sees parts pricing/totals
actual: Same WO 047ffbc5 line columns: Tech+SFD ON = [...,Rate, Margin, Total] (pricing visible); Full+SFD ON = same (pricing visible); Full+SFD OFF = [Name/Description, Actual/Estimate, Progress, Status, Action] with NO Rate/Margin/Total. So pricing columns follow See Financial Data regardless of view mode
reason: Financial columns appear only when See Financial Data is ON, independent of Full/Tech view mode

title: Tech view restriction 1: Estimate column shows Tech Time value
expected: In Tech view the 'Estimate' column shows the Tech Time value (e.g. '2h') not the dollar estimate
actual: WO lines area shows a combined 'Actual/Estimate' column in both Tech and Full view; the available test WO line is a shop-supplies/part line, so a labor line with distinct Estimate=$ vs Tech Time=hours could not be staged to confirm the column renders hours vs dollars
reason: Needs a WO with a labor line carrying distinct Estimate and Tech Time values to verify the swap; not stageable via harness

title: Tech view restriction 2: tech time input field is hidden on WO lines
expected: No tech time input field rendered on lines in Tech view
actual: The line editor is an inline (non-modal) panel; no field explicitly labelled 'tech time' was found, but an hours input placeholder ('#.## hours') is present, and the inline panel could not be cleanly isolated from surrounding WO fields to make a definitive determination
reason: Inline line editor not cleanly isolable via harness; needs manual confirmation of the tech-time input's absence

title: Tech view restriction 4: cannot approve work order lines
expected: No approve-line action visible on individual lines
actual: No approve/authorize action appeared among visible Tech-view buttons, but the line-level more_vert action menu could not be opened via the automation harness (it did not open in Full view either), so the line-level approve action's absence could not be positively confirmed
reason: Line-level action menu not drivable via harness; needs manual verification

title: Tech view restriction 6: labor rate columns and fields hidden on WO lines
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST as Tech, view_mode=tech, SFD ON
expected: Labor rate columns/fields hidden in Tech view even with See Financial Data ON
actual: Tech view (SFD ON) shows a generic 'Rate' column which is SFD-gated (disappears when SFD OFF) — this appears to be the part rate, not a labor rate; the test WO line is not a labor line, so a labor-rate-specific column/field could not be isolated to confirm it is hidden by Tech view
reason: Needs a WO with a labor line to isolate the labor-rate column/field; not stageable via harness

title: Tech view restriction 7: parts request form shows simplified subset of fields
expected: Parts request form shows fewer fields than Full View version
actual: Could not reliably open/isolate the parts request form in both Tech and Full view via the harness to compare field counts
reason: Parts request form flow not drivable via harness; needs manual side-by-side comparison

title: Tech view restriction 8: cannot edit existing WO lines, only create new
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST as Tech, view_mode=tech, WOL Create&Edit
expected: Existing line read-only; new line can be added
actual: Tech view exposes a functional 'New Line' create form (consistent with 'create new'), and no edit affordance was visible on the existing line row; however the line-level edit menu/row-click could not be driven via harness to positively confirm the existing line is read-only (vs a harness limitation)
reason: Existing-line edit path not drivable via harness to confirm read-only; needs manual verification

title: Tech view restriction 9: line becomes read-only after authorization is approved
expected: Pending line editable; after another user approves it, the Tech-view user cannot edit it (read-only)
actual: Requires a multi-user authorization flow (create pending line as Tech, approve as a second user with approve rights, then re-check as Tech) which was not executed via the harness
reason: Multi-user approval flow not executed; needs manual verification

title: View mode is UX-only, not a security boundary
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST as Tech, view_mode=tech, WOL Create&Edit
expected: Add a new line, edit allowed fields, save; save persists (CRUD intact, only UI simplified)
actual: Tech view exposes a fully functional New Line editor with editable fields (Title, description, hours, labor rate) and 'Save & Add Line'/'Save & Add Part' buttons, and the role retains workOrderLinesCreateAndEdit at the permission/data layer - consistent with view mode being UX-only. However the automated save could not be completed through the inline editor (field targeting timed out), so persistence was not directly confirmed
reason: Save action could not be completed via harness to confirm persistence; CRUD affordances present but end-to-end save unverified
